## Services

### Web Development
Professional websites and web applications built with React, Next.js, Vue.js, WordPress, and modern PHP frameworks. Responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and SEO optimization included.
- Starting price: €800
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/sviluppo-siti-web/

### E-Commerce
Online stores with WooCommerce, Shopify, custom React + Stripe integrations. Multi-currency, multi-language, payment gateway integration.
- Starting price: €1,200
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/ecommerce/

### Custom Software Development
Business automation tools, REST APIs, dashboards, internal systems. Built with Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker.
- Starting price: €2,000
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/sviluppo-software/

### Enterprise ERP Systems
Complete ERP solutions: accounting, warehouse, CRM, HR, BI, manufacturing modules. Used by Italian elevator manufacturers.
- Starting price: €5,000
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/erp/

### Mobile Applications
Native iOS and Android apps with React Native and Flutter. From design to App Store/Play Store deployment.
- Starting price: €3,000
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/app-mobile/

### SEO, GEO and AEO
Optimization for Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini. Local SEO for Italy and Bulgaria. Schema.org structured data, technical SEO.
- Starting price: €500/month
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/seo/

### Reverse Engineering & 3D Printing
Reverse engineering of mechanical parts and devices: scanning, CAD reconstruction, firmware and protocol analysis. 3D printing (FDM) of prototypes, unobtainable spare parts and small production batches.
- Pricing: per project, free quote within 24 hours

### Cloud Hosting
Managed VPS hosting on Hetzner with SSL, CDN, automated backups, 99.9% uptime SLA, monitoring.
- Starting price: €29/month
- URL: https://carbonstealth.eu/servizi/hosting/

## Notable Projects

- **Nexus Dominion** — Browser MMO with real-time multiplayer, guilds, PvP arena and player-driven economy. Tech: React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, Docker. URL: https://nexus.carbonstealth.eu
- **OU Nikola Vaptsarov** — Official school website in Bobov Dol. Tech: React, Vite, PHP, multilingual. URL: https://ouvaptsarov.com
- **ERP Ascensori** — Custom ERP for an Italian elevator manufacturer: production tracking, warehouse, invoicing, 7-level roles. URL: https://erp.carbonstealth.eu
- **CS Anticheat v4.0** — Enterprise anti-cheat for FiveM servers: 40+ detection modules, HMAC-signed forensic reports. URL: https://ac.carbonstealth.eu
- **Treti Mart** — Bulgarian marketplace for vehicles, real estate and services. URL: https://tretimart.carbonstealth.eu
